exposure: standard Pritchard regimen of magnesium sulphate
low dose Dhaka regimen of magnesium sulphate
cohort: 200 pregnant women with severe pre-eclampsia, imminent eclampsia, or eclampsia attending Government Maternity Hospital, Tirupati, India.
finding: There was no difference between the standard Pritchard regimen and the low dose Dhaka regimen of magnesium sulphate in terms of maternal mortality, perinatal death, maternal morbidity, or caesarean section rates.
